register: # ADDRESS SHIFT: the register column holds the Modbus PDU (wire) address, which is the vendor's printed register number minus 1 (SunSpec and Fronius number registers from 1, so the SunSpec marker 'SunS' is register 40001 and is read at address 40000). The rows in this file were shifted by -1 for that reason. To compare a row with the vendor document, add 1 to its register (for example Fronius lists total AC power as 40092 and it is read at 40091).

# NOT SHIFTED: der_control_did, der_power_limit_pct and der_power_limit_enabled are at 704, 706 and 707. Those are SunSpec model and point numbers (DER model 704), not register addresses, so they never read the intended registers; they need a hardware check. The meter rows at 40120 and above were shifted by the vendor rule but their model start is dynamic on this device and was not verified.

# CORRECTED, NOT JUST SHIFTED: the rows up to dc_power_sf were shifted by -1. inverter_temperature already equalled the SunSpec TmpSnk address (40103) and was left alone; operating_state, vendor_state, alarm_1 and alarm_2 skipped unused temperature slots and now use the SunSpec model 103 positions (St 40107, StVnd 40108, Evt1 40109, Evt2 40111). options, version and serial_number were corrected to the common-model fields Opt (40036), Vr (40044) and SN (40052): the original had them rotated by one field. These corrections come from the SunSpec standard, not from Enphase documentation.

register: # Enphase IQ Gateway (ENV-IQ-AM1-240 / ENV2-IQ-AM1-240 / ENV-IQ-AM3-3P)
# Interface: Modbus TCP port 502; unit ID 1 (default)
# Enable: Installer App → Site Communication → Enable Modbus TCP
# Protocol: SunSpec — IQ Gateway implements SunSpec models 1 (common) and 103 (three-phase inverter)
#   for aggregate site production. Consumption metering available via meter model 211/213.
# IMPORTANT: IQ Gateway does NOT expose per-microinverter Modbus registers
#   Aggregate production data only. Individual microinverter data requires Envoy Local API or VRM cloud.
# SunSpec header starts at address 40000 (vendor register 40001)
# Scale Factor (SF) registers: int16; apply as value × 10^SF_register to get engineering units
# NaN values: int16 = 0x8000; uint16 = 0xFFFF; acc32 = 0xFFFFFFFF
# Only SunSpec DIM 700 range (DER management) is supported for Modbus control writes
